name: @acegalaxy/ai-gateway
description: Shared runtime LLM call gateway (5-layer default-deny): skill-scoped authz, token budget, circuit breaker, append-only audit, config-driven proxy routing. Consumed cross-project via git-dependency (private — policies/proxy config is internal). private:true blocks accidental public-registry publish.

scripts.copy-assets: mkdir -p dist/authz && cp authz/policies.json dist/authz/policies.json && mkdir -p dist/config && cp config/proxy.json dist/config/proxy.json
